segments.text: And the angel that talked with me came again, and waked me, as a man that is wakened out of his sleep,

segments.speaker: Angel
segments.text: And said unto me,
What seest thou? And I said,

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: I have looked, and behold a candlestick all of gold, with a bowl upon the top of it,
and his seven lamps thereon, and seven pipes to the seven lamps,

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: which are upon the top thereof:

footnotes: seven pipes…: or, seven several pipes to the lamps

segments.text: And two olive trees by it, one upon the right side of the bowl, and the other upon the left side thereof.
So I answered and spake to the angel that talked with me, saying,

segments.speaker: Zechariah
segments.text: What are these, my lord?

segments.speaker: Angel
segments.text: Then the angel that talked with me answered and said unto me,
Knowest thou not what these be?

segments.speaker: the Angel
segments.text: And I said,
No, my lord.
Then he answered and spake unto me, saying,

segments.speaker: the Angel
segments.text: This is the word of the LORD unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, saith the LORD of hosts.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: Who art thou, O great mountain? before Zerubbabel thou shalt become a plain: and he shall bring forth the headstone thereof with shoutings, crying, Grace, grace unto it.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house; his hands shall also finish it; and thou shalt know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me unto you.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: For who hath despised the day of small things? for they shall rejoice, and shall see the plummet in the hand of Zerubbabel with those seven; they are the eyes of the LORD, which run to and fro through the whole earth.

footnotes: for they…: or, since the seven eyes of the LORD shall rejoice

segments.text: ¶ Then answered I, and said unto him,

segments.speaker: the Angel
segments.text: What are these two olive trees upon the right side of the candlestick and upon the left side thereof?
And I answered again, and said unto him,

segments.speaker: the Angel
segments.text: What be these two olive branches which through the two golden pipes empty the golden oil out of themselves?

footnotes: through: Heb. by the hand of
empty…: or, empty out of themselves oil into the gold
the golden oil: Heb. the gold

segments.speaker: Angel
segments.text: And he answered me and said,
Knowest thou not what these be?

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: And I said,
No, my lord.
Then said he,

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: These are the two anointed ones, that stand by the Lord of the whole earth.
